title: Riso Card Zine, now with deep red
question: Same combo, deep cherry red added three ways. The one you pick becomes Today; the others become paper stock for other sections.

options.label: Cherry on Teal
options.lineage: sleepy.tofu cards + the Little Cinema reds
options.thesis: Mint-teal stock, sunflower/pink/sky cards, and deep cherry for the date shadow, countdown and the Solve button.
options.viewport: Hand-lettered date with a cherry misprint shadow, stamped month, MAIN card on top of a fanned hand, one deep-red Solve button.
options.risk: Red is the accent, not the star: it does the important jobs but covers little of the page.

options.label: Cherry Stock
options.lineage: the Tearoom of Terror poster red, printed as the whole sheet
options.thesis: The zine printed on deep cherry paper: cream hand-lettering, sunflower MAIN card, pink and mint cards, sunflower Solve button.
options.viewport: Cream date on cherry, cards glowing against the red, sunflower Solve button.
options.risk: The boldest: gorgeous for Today, but long reading pages need a lighter stock.

options.label: Cherry on Cornflower
options.lineage: your blue-sweater cat and portfolio sky, plus red
options.thesis: Cornflower stock with cream cards and deep cherry plus tangerine: a classic blue-and-red pairing.
options.viewport: Cream MAIN card with a cherry picture panel, cherry bonus card, tangerine side card.
options.risk: Blue plus red can look like a flag if the cream and tangerine get squeezed out.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean study dashboard at the craft level of Duolingo, Brilliant and Notion.
canonCard.viewport: Greeting, streak tile, today's problem card, timer card, calendar card.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other study app: the template feel you asked to avoid.
